'''2007 Corellia Regionals Jacob Adams LS Agents In The Court''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jacob Adams]] at [[2007 Corellia Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|JPSD-L-agentsinthecourt.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Playtesting Mistake
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
